value.rationale: This is a complete structural classification of a natural two-storm saturation-excess model: the sign can reverse only when the antecedent wetness places the capacity strictly between the two possible first-pulse post-storm levels. The unique integrated-loss crossover is universal across capacity and larger-storm amplitude within this regime, and across time-varying proportional loss profiles. This informs interpretation and verification of rainfall/runoff order sensitivity as a mechanistic baseline rather than a field-calibrated recommendation; it is more than one arbitrary computed slice.
